calculations: Distinct e_n have distance sqrt(2); distinct contact points have distance sqrt(2*(1-r^2)).

examples.title: Sharp square-norm constants and flat faces
examples.space: R^2 with l_infinity norm; also embeds in l_infinity(N)
calculations: Contact-map distance has the same ratio as radius distance in this example.
examples.sharpness_scope: Uniform over normed spaces and centers of prescribed norm r, for each 0<r<1. Not applicable at r=0.
additional_checks: c=(1/2,0),v=(0,1): norm(c+t*v)=max(1/2,t), constant before t=1/2 but unique contact at t=1.
c=(-1/2,0),v=(1,0): norm(c+t*v)=abs(t-1/2), initially decreasing but unique contact at t=3/2.

examples.title: Boundary and exterior failures

examples.lesson: The condition norm(c)<1 is essential for a universal all-directions existence and uniqueness theorem.
